evidence.name: Screen field: Rebuild options from the items
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Rebuild options from the items" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Rebuild options from the items
sections.description: A shortcut that rebuilds this variable's options from the screen's current list or grid items so the stored values match what's on screen, handy after you've added or changed items and don't want to re-enter each option by hand. Warning: it replaces the existing options (a confirmation shows old versus new first), so custom options or mappings not present in the items can be lost. Avoid it when the variable is shared with other screens, and most funnels rarely need it once options are set.
